names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 23 Νοεμβρίου, «Όσιος Σισίνιος ο Ομολογητής», with the rank words left off.

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Ο Όσιος Σισίνιος διέπρεψε κατά τον διωγμό εναντίον των χριστιανών, όταν αυτοκράτορας ήταν ο Διοκλητιανός (300 μ.Χ.)». The page gives no year of birth and no year of death — his life runs on past Constantine's accession and into the Arian controversy — so the one year it prints is recorded as a floruit.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιος Σισίνιος ο Ομολογητής»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3077/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Neither of the corpus's two Sisinnius folders is this man — `sisinnius-of-constantinople` is kept on 11 October and `sisinnius-of-milan` on 29 May — and neither is the `sisinnius-22-november` of the day before, who is a hieromartyr killed by the sword and given no city. This one is placed by Cyzicus and by a life that runs from Diocletian's persecution into the Arian controversy. The `confessor` type is the page's own «ο Ομολογητής» and matches its account: he was imprisoned and beaten and then released, and the page does not say he was killed. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
